summary: Re-tested both iter16 fixes end-to-end. BOTH FIXES VERIFIED. The Peptide Price Tool toggle switch on the Settings screen should have a data-testid for testability. However, community-bar save (step 2) which uses the same putAll() code path already exercises the cross-write regression, so functional coverage is complete.
Admin.jsx still ~2130 lines — recommend splitting SettingsPanel/ReviewsPanel/VendorsPanel into own files (repeat comment from iter16).

Backend PUT /settings still uses Pydantic string defaults that silently overwrite unspecified fields. Consider Optional[str]=None semantics so future added settings fields don't require touching every client caller (defensive).
